# Marketplace button artwork

The buttons link to BeastTokens listings on the named marketplaces.

- SpigotMC tap icon: [Simple Icons source](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/1bb2f6e6ea50f920de8d2f3d273ae48564a5eaee/icons/spigotmc.svg), distributed under [CC0 1.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/1bb2f6e6ea50f920de8d2f3d273ae48564a5eaee/LICENSE.md). Brand color: `#ED8106`.
- BuiltByBit cube icon: `icon-blue.svg` from the [official brand kit](https://builtbybit.com/attachments/builtbybit-branding-zip.526769/), displayed in white as provided by the [branding guidelines](https://builtbybit.com/wiki/branding). Brand color: `#2D87C3`.

The marks identify their respective marketplaces. They remain the property of their owners.
